description.en: Shows a message in the dialogue window and waits until the player closes it. It opens the window with CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN(_id, false, false, true, _chara, _bRight), then waits with suspend() until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE() is false, that is until the player has read and closed the message. It is by far the most used helper of the events.
Speaking character (parameter ID or hash), shown as the speaker.
true to show the speaker on the right side.

examples.case: Two lines of dialogue (real usage, from ev42020300.nut)
With a speaker on the right (real usage, from ev44010070.nut)
